_doc: The retirement list of 2026-08-07. ARCHIVE means the file moves under docs/archive/ — retrievable, out of the working set, nothing rewritten. DELETE is reserved for content that provably loses nothing: here, byte-identical duplicates. ADRs are decisions of record and appear in neither list.
_doctrine: Archive is the default and delete is the exception, for the same reason CLAUDE.md:32 says freezing a page beats deleting it: the artifact costs nothing to keep and something to re-derive; what costs is MAINTENANCE and ATTENTION, and archiving removes both.
Nothing here is rewritten, summarised or condensed. A summary is a new document with a new decay curve; a move is not.
ADRs never retire. docs/editorial/decisions/**, docs/design/decisions/** and docs/brand/decisions/** are excluded by rule.
Logs need not survive as documents. git log holds the same events with authorship, diffs and dates, and is the one memory in this company that has never gone false.
executedBy: queue items Q-070 (board) and Q-071 (the rest). Nothing here happens because this file says so — it happens when a session runs the queue item and its verify command exits 0.

archive.why: The working set's single largest document and 87% log by measurement (1,314 of 1,505 lines; run `node scripts/check-working-set.mjs --report`). CLAUDE.md:30 already declares it FROZEN as a tracker on 2026-08-07 — this makes the freeze structural instead of honorary. Its six stacked CURRENT STATE blocks are narrative history; git log holds the same events with authorship and diffs. Nothing is lost: the file moves, it is not rewritten.
993 lines that its own header already calls an archive. It is the archive; it should live in docs/archive/.
